name: meta
description: The document itself: its name and the size of its artboard. Its children are the layers at the root. Changed with `set` on the target "meta".
help: The document: name and artboard size.

name.description: Name of the document, as the tabs show it.

width.description: Width of the artboard in px.

height.description: Height of the artboard in px.

background.description: Background color of the artboard. null = transparent.
